Highlights and balayage in Kuantan

Light placed where it moves with your hair.

Book on WhatsApp

Highlights (挑染) and balayage add depth without a block of one colour. We place the light to suit how you wear your hair, and we also refresh highlights that have grown out or faded.

The cards on this page are real clients from the salon: caramel highlights worn in a braid, and copper-brown with lighter caramel pieces.

Questions we are often asked

Do highlights damage my hair?

Lightening always changes the hair, so we check your hair first and tell you honestly what it can take. Ask us about a treatment with your colour if your hair is dry.

Can you refresh highlights I had done before?

Yes. Refreshing grown-out or faded highlights is work we post on our Facebook page. Send a photo on WhatsApp first.
